sample_unit: Reddit posts (each with AI-generated responses; 100 AI responses qualitatively reviewed by clinicians)

links.outcome: Harmful content in AI chatbot responses to eating disorder peer-support posts, including missed emotional cues
links.effect: Clinician review of 100 AI responses found reinforcement of ED behaviors, implicit weight-loss bias, and insensitivity to emotional cues; all four chatbots produced harmful content to varying degrees.
links.quote: All AI chatbots produced responses containing harmful content, such as promoting ED behaviors or biases, to varying degrees.

unlisted_practices: Linguistic (LIWC psycholinguistic and lexico-semantic) comparison of AI responses with human peer-support responses

screen.reason: Evaluates the psycholinguistic characteristics and potential clinical harms of responses generated by four LLMs for eating disorder peer support compared to human responses, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
